title: Lengths of Bounded-Rank Linear-Order WQOs
exact_target: Compute the length of the embeddability ordering of countable linear orders below each Hausdorff-rank bound, after identifying mutually embeddable orders.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 7500122 (AMR-074-0122). CC BY 4.0.
